$AG_MCM_System_bShowLabels_Help: One switch for every rank label: an adventurer's guild rank after their name, e.g. "Lydia (C)"; the threat rank on an enemy's health bar, e.g. "[C]"; and your own rank beside your level in the menus. Other people's ranks need the Guild's Appraisal skill (Services at a counter). Default: on.
$AG_MCM_System_bShowNotices_Help: The parchment notice for registration, promotion, promotion ready, a completed missive, and entering or clearing a dungeon. Default: on.
$AG_MCM_System_fNoticeSeconds_Help: How many seconds a guild notice stays on screen, plus a brief fade in and out. Default: 5.
$AG_MCM_Debug_bDetailedLog_Help: Adds each kill and each Guild counter action to AdventurersGuild.log (Documents/My Games/your Skyrim/SKSE). When reporting a problem: turn this on, reproduce the problem, then send that file before starting the game again. Default: off.
$AG_MCM_Debug_Prepare_Help: Takes back every Guild ability, perk and party bonus from you and your companions, removes Guild items and stops the Guild's quests, so no stat changes stay in your save. Then save, quit and remove the mod.
$AG_MCM_Debug_Cancel_Help: Changed your mind? Restores your Guild abilities, party bonuses and the Guild's quests. Your Guild record was never touched.
